note: Java bridge: first-class Kotlin support without a Kotlin dependency for Java users. The vespera-bridge JAR now carries Kotlin extensions (VesperaKotlin.kt): suspend fun VesperaRequest.sendAwait() / sendAwait(executor) (coroutine cancellation cancels the CompletableFuture and thereby the native dispatch), a receiver DSL client.get("/users/42") { header("x", "y"); query("a", "1") } for every method, and Pair-vararg query/headers helpers. kotlin-stdlib and kotlinx-coroutines-core are compileOnly (the POM stays empty; sendAwait needs kotlinx-coroutines-core >= 1.7 at runtime). The client API (VesperaClient, VesperaRequest, VesperaResponse, VesperaClientException) carries compile-only JSpecify @NullMarked/@Nullable annotations, so Kotlin sees header()/contentType()/appName() as String? instead of platform types.
